_comment: Shared by blender/generate_tycoon_assets.py (models, board texture) and the Lua scripts (token, building, card and dice placement). Meters; board local frame: origin = board centre on its top surface, +Y = away from seat 1, +X = seat 1's right. The number of spaces comes from data/board.json (4 sides, corners included).

lot._comment: Owned space, on its colour band (space-local x along the band, y toward the board centre). Lot models are built at `scale`. Flag pole at flagX, houses from houseX0 every houseStep, the hotel at hotelX, a landmark's building at landmarkX.

bill._comment: Cash in front of every seat: piles of note bundles (1M, 100K, 10K) at seat-local y, `spread` apart.
